verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is a self-hosted inference engine. It runs locally as a CLI or server on your own hardware, via prebuilt binaries, source builds or Docker, so data location is wherever you deploy it. A community user confirms running it fully self-hosted. The evidence implies residency control through local deployment rather than stating it outright. missing for 10: explicit documentation on where prompts, logs or cached data are stored and how to configure that, and any statement on data leaving the machine (e.g., -hf model downloads from Hugging Face).
